scope: Streaming paged checkpoints with pinned target generations, concurrent writes, and bounded output

runtime_configuration.route: storage-only PagedReadHandle snapshot and file-backed durable base pack; no service route activated
runtime_configuration.target: The writer pins a synced committed target; pack streaming accepts later commits, and publication merges only matching target images while retaining newer WAL locators.
runtime_configuration.pack_output: sorted exact page images; coalesced buffer is four pages (16 KiB), uncoalesced buffer is one page (4 KiB)
runtime_configuration.memory_reservation: CheckpointValidation progress reservation is 6 pages for coalesced output or 3 pages for uncoalesced output; page loader separately charges decoded pages
runtime_configuration.publication: Sync complete or incremental pack; validate it against the pinned target; merge into the latest root without overwriting later writes; sync a next WAL segment at the latest committed LSN; sync WAL directory; publish manifest pointer; then switch writer generation. Process-crash and actual pointer-write faults remain unverified.
runtime_configuration.checkpoint_worker: One active checkpoint job per PagedTransactionWriter; overlapping jobs are rejected, and job drop or publication releases the slot.
runtime_configuration.pointer_faults: Injectable boundaries exist before pointer temporary creation, after temporary-file sync, after atomic rename, and after directory sync; the exercised writer path fails after temporary-file sync.
runtime_configuration.pack_failure: Checkpoint jobs accept a storage fault injector; a page-write failure keeps the manifest selected and releases the single active worker lease when the failed job is dropped.

acceptance_mapping.stream_exact_target_generation_images: partial: VersionIndex::visit_descriptors streams sorted descriptors with bounded traversal state; exact captured generation pack is verified against every source page image after a newer writer commit
acceptance_mapping.incremental_and_complete_checkpoints: partial: PagedTransactionWriter::checkpoint_to_manifest serializes target capture, complete or incremental pack/index construction, next WAL segment creation and sync at the exact captured LSN, manifest publication, and active writer switch; the disk-backed test covers both modes and a normal reopen, while process-crash boundaries and source-catalog/GC integration remain open
acceptance_mapping.coalesced_and_uncoalesced_output: passed: both modes produce complete packs with matching page counts and exact images
acceptance_mapping.forced_cache_misses_larger_than_cache: passed for the fixture: eight indexed pages stream through a two-page decoded cache and source-read count increases
acceptance_mapping.writes_after_target_capture: passed for the serialized writer path: the next transaction enters the newly rotated WAL only after manifest publication and active-segment switch; the integration fixture commits after a complete checkpoint and then publishes an incremental checkpoint
acceptance_mapping.checkpoint_failure_and_old_reader_retent: partial: an integrated fault before the manifest pointer leaves the prior generation selected after reopen and fences the writer after an uncertain result; incomplete-pack and pinned-reader tests pass, while pack/index/WAL I/O faults, process crash recovery, old-reader overlap through the writer API, and pinned-root capacity remain unverified
acceptance_mapping.complete_reopen_oracle: partial: a disk-backed writer test publishes complete and incremental checkpoints, injects a failure before a later manifest pointer, reopens generation 3, and reads the exact generation-3 value; no process crash or pointer-write I/O fault is injected
acceptance_mapping.bounded_memory_and_source_index_disk_res: partial: pack output is bounded to 16 KiB coalesced or 4 KiB uncoalesced; checkpoint insertion and durable root promotion reserve 128 KiB each, and the writer integration uses a 512 KiB progress pool; required loader overlap and source/index disk reservations are not integrated
acceptance_mapping.tiny_capacity_bounded_defer_and_eventual: partial: a 64 KiB progress pool rejects the 128 KiB checkpoint insertion unit before changing root or progress accounting; scheduler defer/wake and eventual progress after capacity release are not implemented
acceptance_mapping.checkpoint_debt_and_time_above_threshold: not implemented; no maintenance scheduler or tenant debt accounting exists yet
